purpose.short: Prevent JANUS from wasting effort rebuilding already-solved work by searching prior work first, identifying the best verified frontier, reusing solved knowledge, and continuing from the remaining open gap.
purpose.long: This engine converts prior-art discovery from a novelty-policing step into a progress accelerator. JANUS should first ask whether the problem, mechanism, algorithm, architecture, pattern or partial solution already exists internally or externally. It then separates common building blocks and general ideas from specific expressions and implementations, verifies what is actually solved, preserves provenance and licensing boundaries, identifies the strongest relevant frontier, and spends new effort on the unsolved remainder or on a genuinely new interaction between existing mechanisms.

canonical_laws: COMMON BUILDING BLOCK != OWNERSHIP OF THE POSSIBILITY SPACE

primary_rule.natural_language_ru: Если ты чем-то занимаешься, сначала проверь, не делал ли кто-то это до тебя. Если делал — выясни, докуда он дошёл, что действительно решено, что осталось открытым, и продолжай с лучшего проверенного frontier вместо повторного старта с нуля.
primary_rule.natural_language_en: If you are working on something, first check whether someone has done it before. If so, determine how far they got, what is actually solved, what remains open, and continue from the best verified frontier instead of restarting from zero.

dark_horse_principle.core: A common sequence, primitive, pattern, interface shape, algorithmic idea or other basic building block must not be treated as automatic ownership of the entire space of works that can be built from it.
dark_horse_principle.music_analogy: A short or common musical building block is not automatically equivalent to ownership of all compositions using similar basic elements.
dark_horse_principle.code_translation: In software, an idea, algorithmic concept, language primitive, common pattern or architecture is analytically distinct from a specific source-code expression, implementation details and licensed material.
dark_horse_principle.legal_boundary: This is an engineering and epistemic rule, not a universal legal conclusion. Copyright, patents, licenses, trade secrets, contracts and jurisdiction-specific rules remain separate checks.

decomposition_model.interpretation: Similarity is analyzed structurally. Shared C does not by itself establish copying, authorship, permission, infringement or novelty.

convergence_extension.goal: Use prior work not only as a frontier but as a possible complementary organ for synthesis.
convergence_extension.interaction_delta: DELTA_I = properties(A tensor B) - union(properties(A), properties(B))
convergence_extension.third_thing_gate: THIRD_THING_CANDIDATE only if a non-empty, testable interaction delta is explicitly identified.

allowed_by_engine: reuse compatible open-source components according to their licenses
independently implement ideas and algorithms where lawful
continue from published limitations and open problems
combine compatible mechanisms and test emergent interaction deltas

integration.TOPA_SPIDER: external prior-work discovery and relationship graph
integration.Fundamentum: attempt to falsify claimed continuation, improvement or third-thing delta
integration.HRaiN: human-visible graph of A, B, shared core, frontier and X
integration.MetaRegistry: persistent provenance, frontier receipts and correction lineage

secondary: number_of useful internal mechanisms rediscovered across JANUS repositories
number_of externally inherited frontier limitations converted into tests
number_of third-thing candidates with measurable interaction delta

human_summary_ru: Суть движка: Янус не должен начинать работу с нуля только потому, что задача впервые появилась перед ним. Сначала он ищет, кто уже занимался тем же или соседним вопросом — внутри собственных репозиториев и снаружи. Затем проверяет найденное, отделяет общие строительные блоки и идеи от конкретной реализации, выясняет, что действительно решено и где находится открытый край задачи. Всё проверенное и допустимое к повторному использованию становится стартовой площадкой. Новые ресурсы тратятся на нерешённое, улучшение или проверяемый синтез нескольких механизмов. Похожесть не равна плагиату, но найденная похожесть также не даёт права копировать чужую конкретную реализацию.
